title: Traditional Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Irish lamb stew made with tender lamb, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of zesty spices.
instructions: Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot and set aside.
Add flour to pot and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add Guinness stout, whisking constantly.
Return lamb to pot and add carrots, potatoes, onions, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Skim fat from surface and serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
